question: Before filing consumer bankruptcy, is an individual required to complete credit counseling from an approved agency?
true_option: Yes — credit counseling from an approved agency within 180 days before filing is generally required
false_option: No — credit counseling is optional for individual filers
true_claim_text: credit counseling within 180 days before filing is generally required
false_claim_text: credit counseling is optional before filing bankruptcy
source: 11 U.S.C. § 109(h) (U.S. Courts, Bankruptcy Basics): individual debtors must generally receive credit counseling from an approved agency within 180 days before filing; failure can lead to dismissal of the case.
